kids.exampleInstructionTitle: Example doctor instruction for a child with diabetes
kids.exampleInstructionText: No candy, soda, juice, or desserts with added sugar. Drink water, eat balanced meals with protein and vegetables, check blood sugar before breakfast and bedtime, take insulin exactly as prescribed, and tell a parent right away if feeling shaky, dizzy, very thirsty, or unusually tired.

psychology.title: Sanadi
psychology.subtitle: AI-powered mental wellness support
psychology.greetingDesc: Your AI wellness companion for mental health support
psychology.notPatientDesc: The patient-facing Sanadi session is built for privacy and emotional safety. Sign in as a patient to preview voice mode, typed chat, and visit summaries.
psychology.careTeamAccessDesc: Crisis events, emotion trends, and physician gates stay in monitoring and clinical tools for authorized roles.
psychology.careTeamAccessContent: Use a patient demo account to walk through the full Sanadi experience end to end.
psychology.calmCompanion: Your calm companion for CBT-style support. Move at your own pace — camera and microphone are always optional.
psychology.chooseBefore: Choose before you begin. Your selection applies until you end the session.
psychology.cameraOptInDesc: Optional face cues for Sanadi — you can turn the preview on or off anytime from Session tools during a visit.
psychology.patientProfileLoading: Patient profile is still loading. Refresh if visit history does not appear.
psychology.beginVisitDesc: سنَدي is a private space for reflection and skills practice. You can pause or end anytime; summaries help the next visit feel continuous.
psychology.visitSettingsDesc: Companion avatar, mood, optional camera, and recognition diagnostics for this visit.
psychology.moodDesc: Blended from your last exchange and optional camera cues.
psychology.companionAvatarDesc: How Sanadi looks in voice mode. Your choice is remembered for future visits until you clear site data for this browser.
psychology.cameraOnDesc: Live video is shown in the floating window. Turn it off here or with the camera button next to the mic.
psychology.cameraOffDesc: Optional — when on, a small preview appears so you can see yourself and Sanadi can use gentle face cues.
psychology.recognitionDebugDesc: Face, speech, and fusion channels from the last message. Console logs mirror this view.
psychology.welcomeMessage: I am Sanadi. I am here with you. Say anything and we will take it one step at a time.
